items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: I says sure, I remember you. I didn't.

ctx.x: And you were in that situation when Russ Morgan contacted you about going to the Goldkette Band?

Yes. Well we were two Pennsylvania guys. And Russ got me on the phone and he said, do you remember me, Russ Morgan? I come from the coal miner country up in Pennsylvania. I says sure, I remember you. I didn't.
